_written: 2026-10-10, BEFORE any gen35 return was computed. User target: net Sharpe > 1.3 AND CAGR > 15% in a strategy usable in a CFT account.
why: E2 alone has Sharpe ~1.36 but crash-wick tails cap CFT-compatible risk at ~6-8% vol (CAGR ~8-11%). Hitting CAGR > 15% at a CFT-safe worst day needs a lower tail ratio, i.e. a diversifier whose bad days differ: macro trend on FX / oil / equity index, tradable with crypto CFDs on CFT's MT5 route.
data: src/qpl/data/macro_daily.py: FRED H.10 FX (EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD NZDUSD USDJPY USDCAD USDCHF), EIA WTI and Brent spot, FRED SP500 (2016-02..2026-02-11; weight 0 after). NATGAS excluded a priori (Henry Hub spot spikes not representative of a CFD). Crypto: Binance spot daily OHLC (BTC, ETH).
macro_sleeve MX: frozen E2 rules, long/short (unclipped: 0.5 * mean of 15 short_breakout(n,h) + 0.5 * mean of 4 tsmom(n)), per asset w = s * min(4, 0.10 / sigma30_ann) / N_t (N_t = assets with >= 200 obs and data that day), held close t -> close t+1 on the asset's own trading days
crypto_sleeve CX: E2 LIQUID2 (BTC, ETH; long-only) as in gen31

costs (MT5 route, UNCERTAIN).FX: 1 bp per unit turnover + 2%/yr on gross notional (swap/markup)
costs (MT5 route, UNCERTAIN).WTI/BRENT/SPX: 3 bp per unit turnover + 3%/yr on gross notional
costs (MT5 route, UNCERTAIN).BTC/ETH CFD: 3.25 bp commission + 5 bp spread per unit turnover + 20%/yr swap on gross notional

intraday lows: crypto: real Binance daily lows; macro (close-only data): adverse excursion = 2.0 x |close-to-close return| when that return is adverse, else 0.5 x daily sigma (k-proxy, conservative)
portfolio P: CX and MX each scaled to 10% annual vol on 2018-01..2021-12 (DEV), summed, then scaled by a single factor to a target vol v
risk choice: v in {0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.14, 0.16}: the largest v whose DEV (2018-2021) worst intraday day > -4.0% and DEV max drawdown > -9%

gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T1: MX standalone net Sharpe >= 0.3 in VAL and in TEST
gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T2: P net Sharpe >= 1.3 over 2018-2026-10 AND >= 1.0 in each of DEV, VAL, TEST (MT5 base costs)
gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T3: P CAGR >= 15% over 2018-2026-10 AND >= 12% in TEST
gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T4: P worst intraday day 2018-2026 > -5% and max drawdown > -10% (CFT 2-Phase compatible)
gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T5: P with stressed costs: net Sharpe >= 1.0 over 2018-2026
gates ('TARGET MET' requires all).T6: CFT 2-Phase simulation on 2023-01..2024-06 starts: P_pass >= 0.60 AND P_fail_daily <= 0.10

trials: 1 portfolio construction (+1 sleeve); cumulative crypto/cross-asset alpha trials 123
